اجتهدوا (form VIII)
# اِجْتَهَدُوا (ijtahadū) /id͡ʒ.ta.ha.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِجْتَهَدَ (ijtahada)
# اِجْتَهِدُوا (ijtahidū) /id͡ʒ.ta.hi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِجْتَهَدَ (ijtahada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
